question: If (cos beta)/(sec alpha) = 15 and (sin beta)/(sec alpha) = 16, then the value of sin²β is ___________.
solution:
**Given**

 (cos beta)/(sec alpha) = 15

 (sin beta)/(sec alpha) = 16

**Calculation**

Sec α = cos β/15 ......(1)

sin β = 16 × Sec α .....(2)

Putting the value of eq (1) in eq (2)

⇒ sin β = 16 × cos β/15

⇒ sin β/cos β = 16/15

⇒ P/B = 16/15

sin2β = P²/H²

H² = P² + B²

H2 = 256 + 225

H2 = 481

sin2β = 256/481

**The value is 256/481.**
